description: List of goods and values in Judaeo-Arabic and Hebrew numerals. Accounts? Dowry list (less likely)? Items include a yellow cup (ṭāsa ṣufra); dishes (aṣḥun); small bowls (sakārij); large bowls (qaṣʿ); fans (marāwiḥ); scrapers (miḥakkāt); sponge (safanja); something Maghribī; a box or case (qimaṭra); combs (amshāṭ); chairs (karāsī); gum (simgh); a wooden mortar or basin (jurn khashab); a container of oil; a table; a lamp; and something to do with cooking.
description_he: רשימת סחורות וערכים ביהודית-ערבית. רשימת נדוניה? חשבונות?
